explanation: Translated Commons CLI 1.9.0 core components faithfully to Python according to the frozen contract. Custom exception hierarchy (ParseException, UnrecognizedOptionException, AmbiguousOptionException, MissingOptionException, MissingArgumentException, AlreadySelectedException) matches Java simple names. Option validation, OptionGroup mutual exclusion and selection, Options storage and lookup, CommandLine query methods, and DefaultParser parsing logic (including partial matching, hyphen processing, quote handling, and token bursting) are implemented using only Python standard library.
